message.content: {"caption":"Four-panel grouped bar chart comparing PPO and GRPO scores across ablations and the full Memory-R1 pipeline.","description":"The chart has four side-by-side panels with grouped coral PPO and turquoise GRPO bars. The y-axis is Score, with ticks from 20 to 60; each panel’s x-axis categories are F1, B1, and J. A legend identifies PPO and GRPO in the first panel. Grey dashed horizontal reference lines appear in the panels; their values are not labelled. Panel a, “w/o Memory-R1 Memory Manager”: PPO scores are 34.5 (F1), 28.1 (B1), and 49.0 (J); GRPO scores are 37.5, 30.6, and 52.9. Panel b, “w/o Memory-R1 Answer Agent”: PPO scores are 32.5, 24.6, and 59.4; GRPO scores are 33.0, 24.9, and 59.9. Panel c, “w/o Memory Distillation”: PPO scores are 39.3, 30.9, and 57.4; GRPO scores are 41.0, 34.4, and 60.1. Panel d, “Full Memory-R1 Pipeline”: PPO scores are 41.0, 32.9, and 57.5; GRPO scores are 45.0, 37.5, and 62.7. GRPO is higher than PPO in every category.
